- Notarized affidavit / certificate of DBA showing Clearwater Tech is a recognized trade name for Clearwater Solutions, LLC
- EIN confirmation letter (CP 575/147C) or an IRS TIN verification letter that shows the legal name and EIN
- A corrected W-8BEN-E where the legal entity name matches the EIN record (signed) — this is usually the fastest if your EIN docs show the legal name as Clearwater Solutions, LLC

Cc'ing Karthik and Monica from Procurement to hold the PO until we receive the supporting evidence. If you can upload a scanned notarized affidavit + corrected W-8, we should be able to unblock within 48 business hours.

If it's helpful, below are the exact fields our onboarding system validates: legal name (line 1), country of incorporation (line 10), EIN in Part I. Any mismatch between line 1 and the IRS record typically triggers the review.
